name: velven
description: Publish browser games, worlds, tools and wonders built with AI to Velven, and add its SDK.

interface.shortDescription: Publish browser games and worlds built with AI to Velven
interface.longDescription: Publish a browser space to Velven's hosting from a folder or a single page: a private preview first, then live on its own Velven page after the safety check. Works before you have an account (an unlisted page with a claim token). Adds sign-in, leaderboards, saves, achievements and rooms through the Velven SDK.
